mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining INDPRO periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
